accepted_claims: The bounded algebraic event engine decides exact rational polynomial sign, exact-zero, multiplicity and singular controls without epsilon or binary-float correctness authority.
Square-free Sturm evidence prevents MC032-A from assigning a sign across a hidden critical root; endpoint zeros and interior roots route to MC032-B.
The analytic adapter accepts only independently certified separated intervals or unique transversal roots with a strict positive derivative lower bound on the same source parameter.
General tangential, multiple and singular transcendental events preserve TRANSCENDENTAL_EVENT_BLOCKER/PB-007-01 rather than being guessed.
Bounded critical-topology event facts require independent event and connectivity evidence plus positive-volume semantics; touching is not material and backend topology is not durable identity.
Event certificates bind input/canonical/sweep/challenge/configuration/decision identity and reject stale or mutated bindings.
Timeout, refinement/resource exhaustion and uncertainty terminate explicitly and cannot become fallback truth.
open_claims: PB-007-01 remains OPEN for a universal exact/certified route through general tangential, multiple and singular transcendental events.
PB-007-04 remains OPEN_PROPAGATED for universal topology/connectivity certification.
PO-04 and PO-07 are not globally discharged by bounded MC-032 evidence.
MC-B, MC-C, MC-D, MC-E, MC-F and MC-1 remain NOT_ESTABLISHED.
adversarial_controls: simple crossing versus even-multiplicity tangency versus odd-multiplicity singular crossing
reject binary floats, epsilon/tolerance and refinement depth as truth authority
reject uncertified/semi-certified analytic evidence and independent parameter projections
preserve PB-007-01 for unresolved transcendental tangency/multiplicity/singularity
convert resource exhaustion to RESOURCE_REFUSAL rather than success
reject touching as positive-volume material and backend topology as durable identity

review.disposition: completed bounded certified classification/event engine; universal transcendental and topology/connectivity blockers remain explicit
review.downstream_release: MC-038 may consume MC-032 bounded event/classification evidence, but MC-032 does not release MC-B; MC-031 and MC-033 remain producing-owner work.

downstream_invalidations: Any implementation that assigns truth from epsilon, binary float, refinement depth, timeout or resource exhaustion invalidates MC-032.
Any analytic event accepted without an independent separated/transversal certificate on the same source parameter invalidates the analytic route.
Any topology claim that promotes touching, kernel component identity or backend topology IDs into positive-volume durable-body truth invalidates MC032-C.
Closing PB-007-01/PB-007-04 or promoting MC-B without independent producing-owner evidence is outside MC-032 authority.
